//: The security boundary. Everything is deny-by-default; you grant surfaces here explicitly. Edit freely — it is re-read every heartbeat.

autoExecute.//: reversible: auto-run reversible allowlisted actions without asking. irreversibleAlwaysConfirm: queue every irreversible action for your confirmation even if it is allowlisted. dryRun: report what every call WOULD do and do neither — how to read a new schedule's task before letting it touch anything.

budgets.//: Call caps counted from the actions audit log. 'default' applies to any tool without its own entry; 'tools' overrides per tool. Absent or 0 = unlimited. Only executed/queued calls count — a denial cost nothing and shouldn't eat the allowance. Example: { "perRun": { "default": 8 }, "perDay": { "tools": { "web_search": 50 } } }

apps.//: Bundle IDs the mac_control tool may touch. Empty = the agent can control no apps. Find an id with: osascript -e 'id of app "Notes"'

web.//: Domains a future read-only web_fetch tool may read.

browser.//: Chrome control via CDP. enabled gates the whole tool. navigateAllowlist limits which domains it may open — [] means any domain. Risky clicks (buy/submit/send/delete) are queued for confirmation regardless.

google.//: Read-only Gmail + Calendar (gmail_search, calendar_upcoming). Requires a read-only token: npm run auth. The OAuth scopes are read-only by construction and must never be widened.

fs.//: Absolute directories read_file/list_dir may read from. Empty = no file access. e.g. ["~/notes", "~/Developer/agentspine/data"]

weather.//: The weather tool (Open-Meteo, no API key). Gated not because the data is risky but because asking about your home town, on a schedule, tells a third party where you live. Set DEFAULT_LOCATION in .env so the location isn't restated in every run.

drafts.//: SPEC §5, preferred path: the agent WRITES, you SEND. A draft is proposed text (email reply, new email, calendar event, note) that lands in the confirmation queue for review; approving it writes a file to dir. This grants NO new OAuth scope — the Google token stays read-only by construction and still cannot send or modify anything.

subagents.//: Delegation to the units in agents/*.md. A subagent's tools are the INTERSECTION of what its file declares and what its caller could already reach, so this grants no capability the agent did not already have — it only lets work be split up. Every call a unit makes still passes through this same broker and this same policy, and per-run budgets are counted across the whole tree rather than reset per unit.

git.//: Absolute repo directories git_status may read. Read-only: branch, uncommitted files, recent commits. Empty = no repo access. e.g. ["~/Developer"]
